reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness voice plugin providing browser speech input, read-aloud output, audio-file transcription, and text-to-speech generation through configurable speech services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音输入、回复朗读、音频转写和文本转语音功能。
summaries.en: Adds speech input, read-aloud responses, audio transcription, and text-to-speech generation to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Captures speech through a browser microphone interface
Converts speech to text using the Web Speech API or a configurable Whisper-compatible endpoint
Reads assistant text aloud using browser speech synthesis
Transcribes audio files through a configurable transcription endpoint
Synthesizes text into audio files through a configurable speech endpoint
